tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po dgra bo'i stobs 'phrog dbang po la ru mtshon 'dzugs pa'i yi ge gtum drag gzi 'bum bzhugs so// bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i rten rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa ru mtshon bca' ba'i thabs la don gsum ste/ sbyor ba dang / dngos gzhi dang / rjes so/ /dang po ni/ rgyu'i khyad par rab chu shing / sing lding / stag pa la sogs pa/ ma 'byor na shol po/ lcang ma/ shug pa la sogs pa'i mdung shing 'dom gang las mi thung ba/ mtshal lam btsag la sogs pa dug khrag dang sbyar bas kha dog dmar por bsgyur bar bya/ gsom dben shing yin pas mi rung / glang ma 'byung po'i bla shing yin pas mi rung / thug lcags mi rta khyi gsum bsad pa'i lcags la dbyibs rtse ༈ thun mong ma yin pa'i ru mtshon rtse lnga la 'khrul nas mdung rtse lnga byed pa ni gang nas kyang ma bshad pas blun po'i rang bzo la ngo mtshar du 'dzin par snang ngo // gsum mam rtse mo gcig pa ral gri'i rnam pa can smad lcags sbubs su yod pa/ rtse mo me ris la sogs pas spras shing rno dbal dang ldan par bya/ thug rnga rab 'brong rnga/ g.yag 'bras bu can gyi rnga ma/ ma 'byor na rnga ma nag po gang yang rung ba rnams shing gi 'khor lo'am/ rgya gram la brten nas mdzes par btags/ mgon po 'khor bcas kyi gsung gi rten du/ srog 'khor sngags can/ 'bod rbad bsad gsum gyi sngags rnams kyi mjug tu rten ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan 'di la brten par bzhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ sgrub pa po bdag gi srung ma mdzod/ mi nor longs spyod dang bcas pa'i gnyer mdzod/ 'gal rkyen sol mthun rkyen sgrubs/ dgra bgegs log pa 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams la ltas dang cho 'phrul drag po mngon sum du phob la/ myur du tshar gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod cig

ces pa shog bu la dug khrag gis bris pa ci mang rnams mdung shing gi rtse mo la dkris pa dar sna dang tshon skud kyis mi chud par bsdams la lcags sbubs su bcug la gzer gyis bsdams/ sku yi rten ro ras sam shog bu la bram gzugs sku mdog sngon po gri gug thod khrag can yum bzhi bcas sor bzhi pa gri khrag gis bris pa la rab gnas tshul bzhin byas/ phyag g.yas nas rim bzhin 'phred la dril bya/ dar skud sna lngas dkris/ dar snas bcings la gri lcags sam/ smyug rgod kyi sbubs su bcug la phyi nas la chas byugs/ srog 'khor kyang de ltar bcings la dril bya/ drag po'i shing tsher ma can la/ byang bu mtho gang pa la bcos pa'i ngos la mgon po yab yum gyi sngags ring thung / mjug tu spel tshig dang bcas pa dug khrag dang snag tshas bris pa la chus byugs/ thugs kyi rten du me long gis ngos su gri khrag dang sin+dhu ras hūm̐ bri dbus dang phyogs bzhi bris pa bzhi dbu phyir bstan dbus ma'i dbu steng du yong bar byed/ yon tan gyi rten du ras sam dar gyi khug ma'i nang du 'bru sna tshogs/ sman sna tshogs/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis bkang pa/ phrin las kyi rten du gang gi shing byang / khrab byang mig dgu pa/ bse byang / stag ras/ gzig ras/ 'gron bu'i len tshar/ dril bu/ g.yer kha/ mi mgo mi lag mi snying la sogs pa dar ras sna tshogs kyi cod paṇa dang / lan tshar ci mang / de dag thams cad gang gi rnga ma'i zhol chen gyi khrod du gdags/ de lta bu'i thug chen de mgon po 'khor bcas kyi rten dang gtor ma legs par bshams pa'i mdun du/ mañdzi chen po la brten pa'am/ phyogs bzhir brgyang thag byas la bzhag de'i mdun du stegs bu'i khar gtor ma gru gsum che ba/ de'i mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon du gru gsum chung ba/ de'i phyed tsam zin pa re mtheb skyus bskor ba sha khrag dang dar gyi brgyan pa/ gsol kha'i chas kyi sha dum bu/

khrag chang / phye mar/ mchod pa rnam pa lnga la sogs legs par bshams/ rnal 'byor pa dpon slob rnams kyis yi dam gyi bdag bskyed/ gtor bsngo bskang gso rnams gzhung ltar byas/ ru mtshon la dmigs te zhi ba zhi drag phyed ma/ drag po rnams kyi sbyong ba/ khrus gsol dang bcas pa bya/ rten dang gtor ma rnams nang mchod kyis sbyang la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ gtor ma mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam pa'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can bsgral ba'i sha khrag gi rgya mtsho/ rus pa'i ri bo zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ zhes brjod cing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ phyag rgyar bcas pa ci mang brjod/ ru mtshon a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi ru mtshon dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang chen por gyur pa'i dbus su dgra bgegs thams cad mnan pa'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag lnga las 'od zer 'phro zhing 'dus pas/ dbus su nag po chen po stobs 'phrog pa'i gzugs can/ srin po khros pa'i cha lugs can cher 'bar ba/ zhal bzhi rtsa zhal mthing nag mi ro dmar chom chom gsol ba/ g.yas zhal dkar la bzhad pa/ g.yon zhal dmar la gdangs pa/ steng zhal rngam zhing gnag pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas dang po gri gug g.yon dang po thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yas 'og ma ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i ral gri dang / res 'ga' mdung thung dgra la 'debs pa/ g.yon 'og mas mi rus kyi phreng ba 'phyar thabs su bsnams shing / bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa mchan khung du thogs pa pad nyi'i steng du zhabs g.yas bskums shing / g.yon brkyangs ba'i gyad kyi 'dor stabs kyis dgra bgegs kyi steng du bro rdung ba/ sku mdog mthing nag dbu skra sma ra smin ma kham nag gyen la 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa/ zhal re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dmar chil bgrad cing me stag 'phro ba/

zhal mche ba gtsigs nas ma mchu 'phyang ba/ mi mgo rdzogs pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcus do shal byas pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs can/ tshangs pa'i skud pas se ral kha byas pa dril bu g.yer kha'i drwa ba 'khrol ba/ drag la rngam pa'i cha lugs can/ ha ha'i gad rgyang / hūm̐ hūm̐ gi 'brug gi sgra/ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ rnam par bsgyings pa'i sgras srid pa gsum po 'dar zhing khri li li g.yo ba/ g.yas su g.yung mo nag mo/ g.yon du gtum mo ljang gu/ mdun du srin mo dmar nag rgyab du sing ga li ser nag thams cad kyang gcer bu/ g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon thod khrag gtso bo la stobs pa/ mtha' skor du dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs srog gi dgu bdud/ las kyi shan pa nyi shu rtsa gcig skye 'gro'i bdud gcod/ dam nyams kyi srog len/ sha la dga' zhing khrag la rol ba/ snying rje med cing khro la rngams pa/ mig rtsa dmar ba kha gdangs pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ gshin rje dang srin po/ bdud kyi cha lugs can/ sa gzhi bar snang thams cad glog gi phung pos bskor ba ltar myur ba'i tshul gyis rgyug cing / ye shes kyi me 'bar bas stong gsum thams cad khyab pa/ bgegs dpung rdul du rlog pa/ de rnams kyi mdun du/ dur khrod kyi sa gzhir/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba'i dbus su bdud rta brag nag rdzu 'phrul gyi shugs dang ldan pa rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa'i steng du/ ru mtshon gyi las mkhan bran bdud gshin rje nag po mun pa'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bdud kyi khram shing rtse mo gsum pa'i mgul na dar nag gi ba dan dang / mi mgo'i lan tshar 'phyang ba sku la brten pa/ g.yon pas mi snying rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa dug sbrul nag po'i zhags pa dang bcas pa zhal du 'jibs cing phyir sprul pa/ lcags kyi ral pa nag po drag tu sprug cing gsig pa/

lcags kyi mche ba zangs yag tu gtsigs nas ya sos ma mchu mnan pa/ sku stod la dar nag gi ber zhal gsol zhing / sku smad gcer bu la dug sbrul mang pos lang long du dkris pa/ skad cig nyid la stong gsum yud kyis bskor zhing dgra bgegs kyi srog dbugs sdud pa'i drag shul can/ de yi g.yon phyogs su ma bdud spu gri'i mched mo dud pa'i mdog srin mo khros pa'i gzugs can/ gcer mo rgyan med rkang pa gsum bgrad stabs kyis gnas pa/ phyag gnyis me dpung 'bar ba 'dzin cing / kha nas me 'bar zhing gdong phyir phyogs pa/ yab yum gnyis ka'ang me rlung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa bdud mgon bdun brgya dang / gza' bdud bdun brgya la sogs pa'i dregs pa can bsam mi khyab pa'i pho nyar 'gyed pa/ thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis ti se bsil ba'i tshal/ po tā la/ ha ha dgod pa'i dur khrod/ dar lung gnyan gyi pho brang / kha'u brag rdzong / dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang nas rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa dang / lho phyogs ri rab kyi khang gseng nas bran bdud gshin rje nag po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi sogs gtor bsngo bzhin dang / las mkhan kun gshegs sogs/ oṃ ma hā kā la ka la sogs/ karma nā tha sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ sogs gtor bsngo sor bzhag la mtshan sngags gong bzhin dam bzhag gtor ma bsngo ba rnams kyang gtor bsngo bzhin gyi rjes su mahā kā la yak+ṣa mud tsa kro dha ya ma rā dza hūm̐ bh+yoḥm ri ma sha mud tsa ya bh+yoḥ sarba bigh+nan sha trun mā ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi kha hi/ lan gsum mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i phyi mchod/ zhal gyi sngags thung / mthar 'bru gsum sbyar ba dang / gong gi ma hā kā la nas mud tsa ya bh+yo'i mthar 'bru gsum sbyar ba'i nang mchod/

dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa dang bran bdud gshin rje nag po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo sogs gtor bsngo bzhin/ rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba las dang / mdun bskyed rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhis gtso mdzad pa'i dam can srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod cing rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa phyogs bcu'i gnas rnams nas byon/ mdun gyi nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang thams cad khyab par bzhugs par bsam la/ dar nag 'phyar/ rol mo rnams kyi sgra sgrog gu gul/ sha chen tshil chen gyi dud pa sbyar dam tshig gi rdo rje dar nag gi g.yab dar dang bcas pa g.yob cing / mi rkang dang shugs pa'i sgras 'bod/ rnal 'byor pa ting nge 'dzin brtan po dang ldan pa/ rnga brdung zhing dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas rnams/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi dad pa dang / /sngon gyi dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /'dir gshegs bdag gi 'phrin las mdzod/ /hūm̐ bh+yoḥ lha mchog nag po mthu bo che/ /lha chen zhal bzhi mthu rtsal can/ /zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyug mchog /bram ze'i gzugs can gshegs su gsol/ /g.yung mo nag mo 'chi bdag mo/ /gtum mo ljang gu bdud mo che/ /srin mo dmar mo gshin rje'i dbang / /sing gling sha za chen mo gshegs/ /shu kra nag po bek+tse mched/ /rjes 'brang rnam gsum dmag dpon bzhi/ /bshan pa nyer gcig la sogs pa/ /'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /sprin ltar 'thibs pas 'dir gshegs shig /glog ltar 'khyugs pas 'dir gshegs shig /'brug ltar grags pas 'dir gshegs shig /thog ltar 'gril bas 'dir gshegs shig

/hūm̐ rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas pa/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /drag po'i las la spyan 'dren gshegs/ /hūm̐ dam can mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas/ /byin rlabs yon tan 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /bde chen 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang / /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /hūm̐ sbyar ba'i spos dang g.yab pa'i dar/ /rnga chen sgra dang dung chen gling / /rnal 'byor drag po'i ngar skad kyis/ /spyan 'dren ma thogs myur du byon/ /dam can rgya mtsho mthu rtsal can/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong ba rnams/ /gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /dam tshig dbang gis 'dus gyur cig /ces yid ma yengs par spyan drangs la/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta ḍom+bhi nī/ tsaṇ+ḍa li/ rak+kha sī/ sing gha lī de bī hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐/ e h+ye hi badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ ma hā kā la yak+ṣa mud tsa kro dha ya ma rā dza hūm̐ bh+yo ma ri ma sha mud tsa ya bh+yoḥ e h+ye hi badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ zhes brjod cing drag rol yun ring du bya/ gong gi mtshan sngags mthar/ grih+ṇe daṃ/ a/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi te shap+ta pra tīts+tsha ye swāhās phyi mchod/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ nang mchod/ rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar nag tsha zhing rtsub pa 'phros/ mdun gyi mgon po 'khor bcas kyi sku la phog pas/ thugs dam gyi brgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas rang 'dra ba'i pho nya las mkhan nam mkha'i mtha' khyab par 'phros/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad/ 'khor 'das kyi nus mthu thams cad tshur 'dus mdun bskyed rnams la thim pas gzi brjid nus mthu blta bas mi bzod pa khams gsum 'dar phri li li yod par gyur/ ru mtshon la rdo rje gzungs thag dang / dar thag btags pa'i sne nas rnal 'byor pa gzhi bsnyen mthar phyin pas bzung /

slob dpon rnams mgrin gcig tu zhal gyi sngags thung dang sngags ring bran bdud sngags rnams brgya rtsa'am/ nyer gcig tsam re 'ur 'don bya/ rnal 'byor pa gcig gam gnyis gsum tsam gyis gzungs thag sogs nas bzung / 'og gi bskul mi byed par sngags thung rgyun ma chad par bzung / gzhan rnams kyis gsol kha bya ste/ de yang sngar gyi stegs bu'i kha'i gtor ma che ba'i g.yas su sha dmar po dum bu dgu dang / chang phud gtsang ma bzhag g.yon du phye mar dang / khrag chab bzhag mdun du las kyi rdo rje zhig gis lcags snod gtsang ma'i nang du g.yas nas sha re/ g.yon nas phye mar mtheb skyu re bcug g.yas g.yon nas khrag chang kyang thigs re blug rnal 'byor pa gzhan rnams kyis rol mo'i bye brag kun thogs nas mdun gyi gtor rdzas rnams dgra bgegs kyi sha'i ri bo/ khrag gi rgya mtsho/ rus pa'i gram khrod chen pos stong gsum thams cad khyab par bsam/ de rnams mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal dmar gnam sa tsam gdangs pa'i nang du sib kyis btab pas hab thob tu bzhes nas thugs brgyud zag med kyi bde bas mnyes nas/ bdag gi ci bcol pa'i las thams cad thogs pa med par bsgrub par bsam la dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i glong dkyil nas/ /zhal bzhi phyag bzhi mthing nag rngams pa'i sku/ /rtsa zhal nag brtsegs g.yas dkar g.yon pa dmar/ /phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon pa thod nang snying / /'og ma ral gri mi rus phreng ba bsnams/ /spyan gsum khro gnyer zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs/ /dbu skra gyen brjes thod skam dbu la bcings/ /mi mgo'i do shal sbrul dang rus pas brgyan/ /dpa' bo stag sham zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /rgyal ba'i bka' bstod nag po che la bstod/ /lha mi kun gyi ded dpon dpa' bo che/ /legs ldan nag po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bka' dang bstan pa srung mdzad dam tshig che/ /zhing skyong chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/

/ma mo kun gyi gtso mo dbang phyug che/ /dur khrod bdag po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /log 'dren dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i mthu bo che/ /ma hā kā la khyod la bdag bstod do/ /zhes pas bstod la/ de nas sngar bshams pa'i kha zas dum bu rnams gtor ma la nar mar bsgron zhing / hūm̐ mgon po'i mtshan gsol dpal ldan nag po che/ /rgyal ba'i bstan srung bka' ba'i bya ra ba/ /gdug pa tshar gcod drag shul mthu rtsal ldan/ /bdud 'dul dpa' bo bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /'dod yon rgya chen gtor ma'i rgya mtsho dang / /longs spyod sna tshogs zhal zas mchod pa 'di/ /dpal ldan nag po chen po'i zhal du 'bul/ /dges pa'i tshul gyi mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /sngon gyi thugs dam gnyen po nyer dgongs te/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen rnams zhi ba dang / /'dod pa'i don rnams 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /ces brjod la/ de nas gtor ma sman rag gi phud bran te dbul/ ho dpal ldan mgon po nag po ma hā kā la/ legs ldan nag po tshogs kyi bdag po/ lha chen dpal 'bar/ 'dod khams kyi dbang phyug dus gsum nad kyi sman pa/ rig 'dzin yongs kyi srog shing / rnal 'byor kun gyi dgra lha/ bdud 'dul rnams kyi dbang phyug mna' zan kun gyi gshed ma/ dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i dpa' bo/ bstan pa srung ba'i mnga' bdag dur khrod gsang ba'i yum bzhi/ 'khor gyi ma mo ḍā ki dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa brgyad/ dmag dpung nyi khri chig stong / lha dmag bye ba dung phyur/ dpal ldan nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /gsol lo/ /mgron no/ /mchod pa dam pa bzhes su gsol/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi nad dang gnod pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams spel du gsol/ dregs pa'i 'gro ba dbang du bsdus/

bar chad dgra bgegs rdul du rlog rgyags chad kyi ma mdzod/ blo lhag gi pha mdzod/ rgyab gyi slog pa mdzod/ mdun gyi 'khar ba mdzod/ nyin gsum gyi bya ra mdzod/ mtshan gsum gyi mel tshe mdzod/ yo na srongs/ 'gyel na slongs/ chad na 'thud/ brjed na bskul/ mgo gang gi yar la bstod/ dkyus gang gi mar la srings/ legs pa brgya dang sprod/ nyes pa stong dang bsnol/ bsam pa rgya mtsho sgrubs/ re ba rgya mtsho skongs/ mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnams bzlog dgra dpung thams cad choms/ bgegs dpung thams cad shigs/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ spo la dar 'phyor/ khrom dung bus/ grags pa 'jig rten kun du sgrogs/ dam chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan nam mkha' la 'phyor/༈ gsol kha'i skabs kyis bstod bskul rnams gzhung nyid las/ ces pa'i bcol kha dang bcol bskul byas pa/ mdun nas bstabs/ yang bshams la/ hūm̐ bskal pa nas 'phyor cig bar g.yas nas bstabs de bzhin rgyab dang g.yon slar yang mdun nas bstabs pa ste tshar lnga byas la snod rnams la bshal chus btang ba'ang gtor mar bstabs la bsdus/ kho bos byas pa'i mnga' gsol gyi gzhung sogs mnga' gsol ci shes rnga rol dbyangs dang bcas pas btang / de nas gzungs thag rnams bkrol/ khrag chang 'thor ba la brtson pas mdun gyi srung ma rnams las pho nya las mkhan stong gsum gyi khams khyab par 'phros nas zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las thams cad thogs med du sgrub cing / khyad par dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad/ sha khrag rus pa sogs rjes med du bzhes/ rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su drangs bar bsam la/ hūm̐ rdo rje 'chang dbang 'phags mchog klu sgrub dang / /ba ling ta pa sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ /mar me mdzad dang grub chen dpal bde ba/ /dri med sbas pa rin chen rdo rje dang / /rat+na kīrti ri sul rnal 'byor ma/

/paṇa chen pa dang 'bum phrag gsum pa'i zhabs/ /lo chen gnyen dang sngags 'chang kha'u pa/ /sa chen kun snying slob dpon rin po che/ /rje btsun grags rgyal sa skya paṇ+ṭi ta/ /chos rgyal 'phags pa dam pa kun dga' grags/ /bdag nyid chen po chos rje bla ma'i zhabs/ /bla chen kun rgyal 'jam dbyangs nam mkha'i mtshan/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug drin chen rdo rings pa/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang tshar chen chos rje'i zhabs/ /mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bsod nams chos 'phel dang / /dbang phyug rab brtan khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba/ /bsod nams mchog grub mkhyen rab ngag dbang dang / /bka' drin mnyam med rmor chen rdo rje 'chang / /dregs byed bran 'khol gnas gsar 'jam mgon che/ /gzhan yang shes rab rgyal mtshan sa lo rje/ /sngags 'chang bdud kyi stobs 'phrog bsod nams dbang / /grags pa blo gros 'jam mgon a mes zhabs/ /bsod nams dbang phyug kun dga' bkra shis dang / /drin can rdo rje 'chang dbang rat+na'i mtshan/ /rnal 'byor rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag gi bar/ /bsten cing bsgrubs pa'i lha mchog mthu bo che/ /gsol zhing mchod pa'i lha chen nag po che/ /rbad cing bskul ba'i zhing skyong drag shul can/ /dgra bo'i stobs 'phrog dpa' bo bram ze'i gzugs/ /rab 'jigs yum chen 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho bcas/ /gson cig dgongs shig ye shes dbyings nas gzigs/ /rbad do bskul lo dam tshig gnyen po dgongs/ /khros shig chos shig drag po'i las la bh+yo/ /sngon gyi khas blangs dam tshig dran gyis la/ /ma thogs rings pa'i tshul gyis 'phrin las mdzod/ /hūm̐ he ru ka dpal thugs rje'i rnam 'phrul mchog /dbang ldan zhing skyong drag po khros pa'i gzugs/ /dgra bo'i stobs 'phrog gzi ldan dbang phyug che/ /ha ha dgod pa'i dur khrod dag nas bzhengs/ /gtum chen dpa' bo 'jigs rung bram ze'i gzugs/

/ma mo mkha' 'gro bye ba'i tshogs kyi gtso/ /ro gdan 'bar ba'i gnas kun khyab par nyul/ /bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod gnas nas bzhengs/ /mthong bas dgra bo'i srog 'phrog mi bsrun pa/ /srin po gdong bzhi khros pa'i gad rgyang sgrog /sprul pa yang sprul bye bas srid gsum 'gengs/ /lho phyogs gru 'dzin ri bo'i ngos nas bzhengs/ /ro thang 'bar ba nag po'i grong khyer nas/ /baṃ ro brtsegs pa'i khri la 'gying bzhin du/ /ro langs dregs pas bskor ba'i nag po che/ /nub phyogs sing ga la yi gling nas bzhengs/ /rab 'jigs btsan rgod drag po'i tshul bzung nas/ /snang srid lha srin yongs kyi dmag sna 'dren/ /mi bsrun k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ sgra sgrog dmag dpon che/ /gangs dkar ti si'i gnas nas sku bzhengs shig /'phags yul de wi ko ṭa'i ri sul nas/ /rnal 'byor dbang mo gnyen lo chen po yis/ /bran du bkol ba'i dgra bo'i shan pa che/ /dar lung me 'bar gnas nas sku bzhengs shig /sngags 'chang dbang po dar ma rgyal mtshan gyis/ /mngon sum zhal gzigs da lta kha'u yi/ /brag la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor srung ma khyod/ /gram stod kha'u'i brag rdzong gnas nas bzhengs/ /'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul rje btsun sa skya pa/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal/ /brten cing bsgrubs pa'i bstan pa'i srung ma che/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang nas bzhengs/ /bka' drin mnyam med rje btsun rdo rje 'chang / /mthu stobs dbang phyug rdo rings kun spang nas/ /mngon sum zhal gzigs bran ltar las kun sgrubs/ /drin chen bla ma'i bka' srung dbyings nas bzhengs/ /gzhan yang rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan dang / /sa skya lo tsā sngags 'chang chos rje nas/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rat+na'i mtshan can bar/ /dngos brgyud phrin las sgrub khyod dbyings nas bzhengs/ /gnas gsar 'jam mgon ༈ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i rdo rje'i zhes gsung rgyun/

rdo rje'i dam tshig gis/ /bran dang grogs kyi tshul du bka' bsgos shing / /bdag gi dus kun mchod cing sgrubs pa yi/ /dam nyams srog 'phrog bshan pa da bzhengs shig /hūm̐ bh+yo khyod ni chos dbyings bde chen klong yangs nas/ /gdug can dam nyams dgra bo'i tshogs rnams la/ /khros pa'i rnam 'gyur mi bzad rngam pa'i nyams/ /mthong bas dgra bo'i srog 'phrog bshan pa che/ /mun pa bye bas byugs 'dra'i srin po'i gzugs/ /khrag rgyun 'bab pas zhal dmar cher gdangs shing / /rno dkar mche ba zangs yag rab tu gtsigs/ /glog dmar 'khyug 'dra'i ljags 'dril skan sgra sgrog /dam nyams baṃ ro dmar po chom chom za/ /khyod zhal mthong bas dgra bo'i snying dmar 'byin/ /sdang mig 'od kyis bgegs dpung thal bar sreg /skan sgra brdabs pas dam nyams klad pa 'gems/ /ha ha'i gad mos srid gsum 'dar zhing g.yo/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ nga ros gdug can mgo bo 'gems/ /k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ bzhad sgras sde brgyad bran du 'khol/ /phaṭa phaṭa dgra bo+o sgrol ba'i las la brtson/ /phyag g.yas rab 'bar gnam lcags gri gug gis/ /dgra bgegs srog rtsa gcod cing snying dmar gtubs/ /g.yon gyi dang po'i thod chen yangs pa'i nang / /dam nyams snying khrag khol ma 'thung zhing rol/ /mdung rnon rtse gsum ral gri 'bar ba yis/ /dgra bo'i mgo lus nang khrol dum bur gtor/ /dung chen phreng ba bdud rtsi'i bum bzang thogs/ /rkang gling sgra yis gnas gsum mkha' 'gro 'bod/ /rgyal ba'i bstan srung zhing skyong nag po che/ /rnal 'byor dgra lha mthu ldan dpa' bo che/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can bstan dgra'i gshed ma che/ /dgra bo'i stobs 'phrog dam nyams bshan pa che/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /bskul lo bskul lo drag po'i las 'di sgrubs/ /rbad do rbad do dam nyams srog rtsa chod/ /zo zhig zo zhig dgra sha snying dmar zo/ /bh+yoḥ khrag gis myos pa'i 'jigs rung srin mo bzhi/

/khrag ral sprug cing stong gsum skad cig myul/ /khrag dmar dang bcas dgra bo'i sha la rol/ /khrag 'thung yum chen rnam bzhi'i dus la babs/ /dgra snying dmar po 'byin byed bshan pa'i tshogs/ /srog 'phrog las mkhan dmar nag rjes 'brang gsum/ /dgra yul thal bar rlog pa'i dmag dpon bzhi/ /dgra 'joms ro bshan pho mo'i dus la babs/ /chos 'khor skyong ba'i gtsang rigs mgon po'i tshogs/ /dam nyams dbugs len bdud nag gnod sbyin bzhi/ /srog gcod gshin rje zhing skyong sde brgyad dpung / /chos shig bskul lo thugs dam dus la babs/ /zhing skyong dbang po bka' nyan 'khor bcas rnams/ /mngon spyod drag po'i las la chas pa'i tshe/ /ro la rngams pa'i srin po pho mo'i tshogs/ /mthong ba'i mod la dgra bo'i snying dmar 'byin/ /hūm̐ phaṭa phaiṃ sgras srid gsum 'dar zhing g.yo/ /ha ha'i gad rgyangs dgra snying dum bur 'gem/ /'o dod khu sgras 'jig rten ma lus khengs/ /'ur chom thug chom sa chen dum bur 'khrugs/ /mi nag 'jigs rung mon pa a tsa ra/ /bya nag gcan gzan ltas ngan pho nya'i tshogs/ /thog ser glog dmar me chu 'khrugs cing 'thab/ /rgyob gsod shugs sgra mi rkang sgra chen sgrog /zhing skyong pho mo srog bdud bshan pa'i dpung / /lha srin sde brgyad sprul pa yang sprul bcas/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i yul du dmag la chos/ /bstan dgra'i sha khrag bza' btung skal bar gyis/ /snying dmar thon la khrag dron thang la phos/ /nang khrol klad pa rkang dmar chem chem zo/ /mi pags rlon pa khrag 'dzag gos su gyon/ /rgyu rlon mgo phreng 'jigs rung rgyan du gyis/ /phyogs mtshams kun nas 'ur 'ur sgra sgrog pa'i/ me dpung 'bar bas dgra yul gzhob tu sregs/ /'thor byed dus mtha'i rlung nag 'tshub ma yis/ /dgra yul phyogs kun 'thor la brlag par gyis/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rnams/ /phrin las rnam bzhi'i bya ba mthar phyin nas/

/bsam pa'i don rnams yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /tshe 'dir rdo rje 'dzin dbang 'grub par shog /bran bdud bye brag tu bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ ri rab ri yi rtsa ba nas/ /las mgon chen po sku bskyod cig /nam gyi gung la nyin gung la/ /dam nyams dgra bo gsod cing byon/ /'khor ni bdud mgon bdun brgya dang / /gza' bdud bdun brgya pho nyar bcas/ /dam las 'das pa'i dgra bo rnams/ /mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /mthun pa'i yo byad ji snyed rnams/ /tshogs bcas 'bul lo bstan pa'i las/ /bdag cag bsrung phyir 'di bsten no/ /nag po dran phyir 'di bsten no/ /bka' las ma 'da' 'dir bzhugs shig /dgos 'dod sgrub phyir 'dir bzhugs shig /ji srid ma gshegs bar dag tu/ /gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs nas kyang / /gang bcol las rnams sgrub tu gsol/ /ces brjod/ de nas mgon po 'khor bcas 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i/ ru mtshon gzi brjid nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ 'phyar ba dang phyogs su gdengs pa tsam gyi dgra bgegs logs 'dren thams cad char gcod pa'i nus ldan du gyur/ zhes brjod/ de lta bu'i ru mtshon de nyid mdun gyi mgon po 'khor bcas sogs la rten du 'bul ba'i tshig 'di brjod/ hūm̐ dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /yi dam rgyud sde bzhi yi lha/ /dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /lha srin dregs pa 'khor bcas dgongs/ /lha mchog ma hā kā la ni/ /lha chen nag po zhal bzhi pa/ /gzi ldan dbang phyug bram ze'i gzugs/ /bsnyen sgrub las gsum las bzhi'i mgon/ /g.yung mo gtum mo sring mo dang / /sing gha li bzhi sbyor sgrol yum/ /shu kra nag po beg tse mched/ /rjes 'brang rnam gsum dmag dpon bzhi/ /ro bshan nyer gcig sprul 'khor bcas/ /zhing skyong pho mo 'bum sde dang / /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad rnams/ /bdag la brtser dgongs rten la bzhugs/

/dur khrod 'bar ba'i ro thang 'dir/ /khrag mtsho 'khyil ba'i rba klong ljongs/ /dam nyams baṃ chen bsgyil ba'i khrir/ /brtan par btsugs pa'i ru mtshon mdung / /dpag bsam ljon pa'i srog shing rtser/ /rno dbal gri lcags mdung so la/ /dug khrag sngags rgod dar dang ldan/ /lhab lhab 'bar ba'i me 'od can/ /g.yag rgod rog po'i rnga g.yab kyi/ /zhol chen sprin nag lta bur gtibs/ /dar nag ba dan 'phan rtse gsum/ /rlung gis bskyod pas 'phur lding g.yo/ /sku rten ro ras tsakli/ /gsung rten srog 'khor gsang ba'i sngags/ /thugs rten gsal ba'i me long dang / /yon tan rten du nyer lnga'i rdzas/ /phrin las rten du dar ras 'phan/ /bse lcags shing byang dam nyams kyi/ /mgo lag 'gron bu'i len tshar can/ /dril bu g.yer kha'i sil sil khrol/ /phun tshogs rgyu las legs grub cing / /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin brlabs pa'i/ /thugs chen 'bar ba drag po'i rten/ /rten mchog ru mtshon rgyal mtshan 'di/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /bzhugs pa'i pho brang chen por 'dzugs/ /byin rlabs thugs rje'i sprin sngon las/ /dngos grub char rgyun dus 'dir phob/ /dam can srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /'du ba'i gnas dang rten du 'dzugs/ /pad ma'i mtsho la ngang pa ltar/ /'bral med 'dus nas las kun sgrubs/ /dregs byed dmag dpon Hdkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gi srung ma mdzod/ mi nor dgon gnas longs spyod dang bcas pa'i gnyer mdzod/ bstan pa rnal 'byor pa la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can skad cig nyid la tshar chod/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi srog la dbang mdzod cig ces lan gsum brjod cing me tog gtor/ shis brjod kyi tshig skabs su gang babs brjod/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ gtor sgrub kyi lhan thabs las 'byung ba ltar bya'o/ /de ltar srung ma rnams la ru mtshon btsugs pa'i phan yon ni/

ru mtshon gyi rten de nyid gang du yod par/ dam can srung ma'i tshogs rnams mkha' la sprin 'du ba'am/ mtsho la ngang pa 'du ba'am/ sha rul la sbrang ma 'du ba ltar gnas de nyid du brtan par bzhugs nas yul phyogs dge mtshan ldan pa dang / sgrub pa po rnams gyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'dod don thams cad sgrub par 'gyur bas tshul 'di la brtson par bya'o/ /zhes rgyal ba'i bstan srung dbang po rgya bod kun nas 'gran zla bral zhing gnyen lo tsā ba chen po dang gnam kha'u pa chen pos bla ma sa skya pa chen po la mgon po 'di'i chos skor yongs rdzogs bka' gtad bcas gnang ba nas bzung rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud rim par byon pa rnams dang / de'i zhal slob bstan 'dzin spyi dang bye brag rje btsun rdo rings pa chen po rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa la shin tu 'go ba'i chos skyong khyad par can dpal stobs 'phrog dbang po 'di la sngon chad ru mtshon 'dzugs chog zur pa'i yi ge zhig ma mthong nas gser 'phyang gi lo dpal sa skya'i gdung brgyud dag gi mtshan can dang / e wam̐ mtshan can gnyis chos khri chen po mnga' gsol 'phrin bcol ru mtshon 'dzugs chog bcas bgyis skabs sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos tshar chen chos kyis rgyal po mdzad pa'i dpal ldan sa skya'i dam can srung ma rnams la ru mtshon 'dzugs chog nyid gtso bor bzung bskyed chog dang / gsol kha kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa pas mdzad pa'i/ 'di'i gtor ma zhi drag gi cho ga gnam lcags 'bar ba nas kha skang bskul tshar chen chos rjes mdzad pa'i gdong brnyan 'khor mang la bstod pa'i bskul sor bzhag la tshig kha yar bcos nas/ don la rang bzo'i dri ma phra mo tsam yang med par/ dag par sbyar ba 'di'i dge bas zhing bskyong dbang po 'khor bcas mnyes nas phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med du sgrub pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur cig/
